subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept both `browser.ssrfPolicy` private-network authorization and the provider-scoped `models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork` authorization through the shared configured-request path?
rationale: Both settings are explicit operator opt-ins, but applying browser policy to a model-provider HTTP request crosses a security-policy boundary that should be confirmed rather than inferred from sibling behavior.

options.title: Approve both canonical opt-ins
options.body: Keep the current implementation, require current-head provider-path deny/allow proof, and merge after provider/security-owner review.

options.title: Use provider-scoped opt-in only
options.body: Remove the browser-policy resolver and authorize private xAI image endpoints only through the sanitized xAI provider request setting.

options.title: Retain hard deny
options.body: Keep xAI image generation unable to reach private networks and close the linked bug as unsupported policy.

recommendation.title: Approve both canonical opt-ins
recommendation.body: Keep the current implementation, require current-head provider-path deny/allow proof, and merge after provider/security-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged the original xAI image-generation feature and is the strongest available owner for the security-policy scope decision.
